scope: G16 read-only citation provenance; G17-G20 paused
change: A reviewer-entered citation must be supported both by a same-task persisted source receipt and by source content in the saved input of a successful model call that produced the final answer. The visible tool message is checked with the same source hash, unit, optional block/version, row and excerpt rules.

negativeCases: A saved source read that never entered the final-answer model request is rejected
A model-visible source message with a changed excerpt is rejected
A model-visible source message with a different call ID is rejected

limitations: This does not prove that the final user-visible answer displayed the citation.
No frozen Gold, real dual-arm execution, independent provider receipt, or final G16 quality acceptance was produced.
